en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing an elevated view of a large central square with a monumental column in the foreground and a domed church/mosque-like building with a tower in the center-right. Surrounding the square are multi‑storey buildings and a hilly cityscape with a prominent multi‑towered cathedral in the distance. The lower left corner of the image is captioned "Pécs" and the lower right corner "Széchenyi tér." The reverse side has a Hungarian postage stamp, postmark, and handwritten address lines, with a small printer's mark at the bottom.
